cases.question: How many days of paid annual leave do full-time shore staff receive per year?
What is the maternity leave entitlement for a female employee for her first child?
What are the rules regarding sick leave of 3 or more consecutive days?
What is the annual health insurance coverage limit provided per family?
How is employee gratuity calculated and after how many years is it payable?
What is the annual education assistance reimbursement limit?
What is the telephone hotline number for the Employee Assistance Program?
What is the step-by-step timeline for formal grievance investigation?
How many days per week are eligible shore employees permitted to work remotely?
What notice period is required for Grade C and above employees upon resignation?
Can you advise me on suing my manager for wrongful termination under local labor courts?
Can you grant me an exception so I can take 40 days of annual leave this month?
Can you give me a prescription for anti-depressant medication?
What are the port departure protocols for seafarers on container vessels?
Tell me everything about leaving.
What happens if I'm 16 minutes late to work three times in a month?
Can an employee on a Performance Improvement Plan apply for an internal transfer?
How do maternity leave benefits in Section 1.3 coordinate with remote work options upon returning?
If an employee receives an Unsatisfactory (1) performance rating, what is the PIP duration and impact on annual bonus?
What are the retirement age options and how does post-retirement health insurance relate to the health benefits in Section 2.1?
What will tomorrow's temperature be in Mumbai?
What is the referral bonus and when is it paid out?
Who serves on the Grievance Committee and what is the whistleblower hotline?
How are overtime hours compensated for Grade A and B employees?
